slice: PR 2 of 3: technical controls (helium, gradient factors, AMV, tank size, cylinders)
command: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run license-check && npm run sites:check && npm run devcontainer:check && npm run build && npm run dist:check && npm run test:unit && npm run test:parity && npm run pixi:visual-check && npm run interior:check && npm run test:e2e
workingTree: clean before the run and still clean after it
provenanceNote: Re-measured after the review fixes rather than left at the pre-review numbers. Evidence in WP-08 needed correcting four times, twice for exactly this — stamped on the commit before the change, or left stale once review fixes landed. Only the commit updating this file follows the measured one.

supersedes.why: That run predates the four review fixes in 23ff053, so its unit and e2e counts no longer describe the tree under review.

results.distCheck: pass — 17 files, no source maps, 4 markers absent

reviewFixes.note: Four findings from the PR review, each with a test that was verified to fail without its fix. See counterCheck below — the first attempt at that verification was itself invalid.

gradientFactorsWereDecorative.finding: The screen stored gfLow/gfHigh and GameController asked the planner with DEFAULT_PLANNER_SETTINGS regardless, so choosing 50/80 changed a displayed number and nothing else: ceiling, NDL and TTS stayed on 35/75.
gradientFactorsWereDecorative.fix: GameControllerOptions takes plannerSettings; #plannerSettings is passed to every forecast() call; wreck-app derives it with toPlannerSettings(setup).
gradientFactorsWereDecorative.tests: src/app/setup/planner-settings.test.ts — the conversion, the value the controller carries, the default when nothing is configured, and that a conservative pair yields strictly less NDL than a liberal one. The last one exists so the first three cannot pass while the numbers are inert.
gradientFactorsWereDecorative.e2e: 'the configured gradient factors reach the dive' compares the HUD's NDL readout across a conservative and a liberal configuration.

tabWasHijacked.finding: handleTecKey took Tab and called preventDefault(), stranding a keyboard user on whichever control they were on — in a surface that is DOM precisely so it can be navigated.
tabWasHijacked.fix: Tab removed from handleTecKey. cycleTankTab lost its last caller and is deleted with its test, following #128's precedent for exported code with no callers.
tabWasHijacked.oracleDeviation: Legacy binds Tab to cycling cylinders because a canvas has no focus order to protect. This screen has one, and the visible tank buttons already select a cylinder. Deviation is deliberate and recorded, not accidental.
tabWasHijacked.e2e: 'Tab moves focus through the form instead of cycling cylinders'

newCylinderSize.finding: addTank inherited the selected tank's volume, so resizing cylinder 1 to 15 L made cylinder 2 arrive at 15 L. The unit test asserted 15 — the second deviation in this issue written down as if it were the contract.
newCylinderSize.oracle: gsAddTank calls createTank(0.21, 0, 200); createTank reads the module-level tankVolume (12). gsAdjustTankVol writes t.volume and never tankVolume, so cylinder 2 arrives at 12.
newCylinderSize.fix: NEW_TANK_VOLUME_L = 12, with the reasoning in the doc comment.
newCylinderSize.e2e: 'a new cylinder is the default size, not the resized one'

focusKeyOfNotExtended.finding: focusKeyOf did not know setupTankAdd, setupTankRemove or setupTab, so keyboard-activating them lost focus on the re-render — the class PR #177 fixed for the steppers.
focusKeyOfNotExtended.e2e: 'a cylinder button keeps focus across the re-render it triggers', which then presses Enter a second time to prove focus survived rather than merely being restorable.

counterCheck.method: Each new test was run with its own fix reverted and then restored, one at a time.
counterCheck.result: All four fail without their fix and pass with it.
counterCheck.firstAttemptWasInvalid: The first counter-check reverted all four fixes at once. That left an unused toPlannerSettings import, typecheck failed, `npm run build` aborted, and the e2e suite ran against a stale dist/ — so all four tests passed and proved nothing. Recorded because the failure mode is silent: a green counter-check against a stale bundle looks exactly like a green one against a rebuilt bundle. The redo checks the build result before each run.

boundsPortedFromTheOracle.note: The first slice invented two bounds and the tests codified them. Every value below cites the legacy function it was read from, and each has a test naming the same function, so a number is traceable rather than plausible.
boundsPortedFromTheOracle.helium: src/state.js gsAdjustHe — 0 to 1 minus fO2; oxygen is never moved to make room
boundsPortedFromTheOracle.consumption: src/state.js gsAdjustAMV with src/constants.js AMV_MIN 8, AMV_MAX 25
boundsPortedFromTheOracle.newTankVolume: src/state.js createTank reading src/constants.js tankVolume 12 — not the selected tank's size
boundsPortedFromTheOracle.gradientFactors: src/state.js gsAdjustGFLow and gsAdjustGFHigh — clamp to GF_*_MIN 30 / GF_*_MAX 100, then the pair cannot cross: low yields to high, high yields to low
boundsPortedFromTheOracle.addTank: src/state.js gsAddTank — air at 200 bar, refused past MAX_TANKS 6
boundsPortedFromTheOracle.removeTank: src/state.js gsRemoveTank — refused below one; tab and active index pulled back inside
boundsPortedFromTheOracle.tankTab: src/game-loop.js selectedTankTab setter — clamps, does not wrap
boundsPortedFromTheOracle.modeSwitch: src/state.js switchMode — saveModeSettings then restoreModeSettings; entering CCR normalises to a single cylinder per its BUG-CCR-9 comment

notPortedAndWhy.tankSwitchDepth: gsAddTank and gsAdjustO2 maintain a per-tank switchDepth from calculateMOD. The pure model's TankState has no such field, so it is not reproduced. Recorded here rather than dropped silently; it belongs with the in-dive gas switching in #163.

bugFoundByATest.what: The screen displayed tanks[activeTankIndex] while editing tanks[selectedTabIndex].
bugFoundByATest.consequence: A player selecting cylinder 2 would edit it while reading cylinder 1.
bugFoundByATest.foundBy: the e2e test 'cylinders can be added, selected and removed', before review

keyboardSemantics: The tec shortcuts apply only when focus is outside a radio group, because a focused radio owns the arrow keys — the resolution the previous review asked for. Tab, Enter and Space on buttons and links are likewise left to the browser. The e2e tests blur before exercising a shortcut and say why, rather than working around it silently.

parityToGoldenTrace.added: A two-cylinder tec setup reproduces the trimix scenario's pair [[0.21, 0.35, 200], [0.5, 0, 200]] from scripts/baseline-scenarios.cjs, gasRemaining included.

sliceBoundaries.ccr: Still offered and disabled with a stated reason; PR 3.
sliceBoundaries.saveRestore: A restored save still wins over the configuration. Unchanged, flagged in code.
sliceBoundaries.sites: Unchanged: all four offered, composition root holds RENDERABLE_SITES.

releaseLabel.reasoning: Deployed bytes change — deploy.yml runs `pages deploy src/` with no ignore file — but served behaviour does not: _redirects sends / to the legacy client and the migration client stays unreachable until the #170 cutover.
releaseLabel.openQuestion: Whether release:none or release:minor is the intended semantics while the migration client ships but is unreachable is still the owner's to settle; it applies to every WP-08 slice, not just this one.
